methodology.policy: Conservative three-way classification: reject only when every high-confidence flat-block signal matches; approve only when every detailed transparent-sprite signal matches; route the wide middle band to manual review.
metrics: alpha levels, occupied-pixel share and occupied bounding box
exact and 4-bit-per-channel quantized opaque color diversity
opaque color and luminance Shannon entropy
adjacent opaque-pixel color transitions and strong detail
knownLimitations: A deliberately minimalist, low-color retro sprite on a large transparent sheet can resemble a placeholder and should be manually restored if its rejection is wrong.
A richly textured but lore-inaccurate or composited image can pass bitmap-quality thresholds; this report does not replace character-fidelity review.
White frame guides, duplicated animation poses, anatomy errors and copied/licensed art are not reliably detected by these numeric metrics.
needs-review is intentionally broad and is not permission to provide the bitmap to ImageGen.
